note: DigiLocker document-signing keys that zkID verifiers trust for PAN Verification Records. Public keys, not secrets: each is the key of the X.509 certificate DigiLocker embeds in every record it signs. The certificates are not committed, because their subject includes an individual's e-mail address; their SHA-256 is. packages/issuer-registry/build.mjs makes registry entries from this file.

keys.source: The certificate embedded in the owner's DigiLocker records: a PAN Verification Record downloaded on 2026-10-27, the same record downloaded again on 2026-11-05 and fetched again from the Income Tax Department that day, and a driving licence record. All four carry this one certificate.
keys.evidence: Every one of those records verifies under this key. The certificate's chain to ProDigiSign Sub CA DSC 2022 and India's CCA root was not checked.
